bullets.text: In Thiruthani, a theater employee named Raja was hacked to death by a gang in front of his wife and daughter after he questioned youths who harassed his daughter, and the police are searching for the suspects.
In Thiruthani, devotees sustained injuries at the Murugan temple when a statue collapsed and fell on people waiting for darshan, and the office should monitor medical assistance.
Untreated sewage stagnating near the Pattabiram railway station has degraded borewell water and raised public health concerns, and the office should watch local remediation efforts.
Minister Dr. K.G. Arunraj stated that the victory of TVK candidates in the by-election is certain, and the office should note these political developments.

With the northeast monsoon nearing, canal networks in Porur, Iyyappanthangal, Kummananchavadi and Kolathuvanchery show pressure and waterlogging concerns, and the office should monitor flood preparedness.
The Greater Chennai Corporation asked the NHAI to clear Cooum River obstructions by October 15 for the port-Maduravoyal project, and the office should watch compliance.
Southern Railway is using software simulations to fix the unsafe gap at Adambakkam MRTS station platform, and the office should track progress.

In Tiruvallur, the district administration tightened surveillance on paddy movement after complaints of traders bringing bags directly to procurement centres, and the office should monitor enforcement.
The Pattabiram Road Over Bridge second arm remains incomplete nearly a year after the railway deadline, causing delays, and the office should review the completion schedule.
Commuters face daily delays on the Chennai-Arakkonam suburban route after yard upgrades, and the office should check railway remediation measures.

The University of Western Australia received final UGC approval for its international branch campus in Chennai, establishing the first foreign higher education campus, and the office should note this milestone.
Industry reports project India's data center capacity to reach 6 GW by 2030, driving demand for specialized roles beyond software, and the office should track infrastructure growth.

Following controversy over a morphed AI video featuring Janhvi Kapoor and Jr NTR, former FTC chair Lina Khan warned that AI self-policing has failed, and the office should monitor regulatory discussions.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to travel on the Poonamallee-Porur metro line and lay foundation stones for new projects, and the office should coordinate preparations.
